answer_1.quote: We designed and built an adaptive writing support system that provides students with individual feedback on their cognitive and emotional empathy skills.

answer_4.quote: We received 58 valid results ... we measured the intention to use (ITU) by asking three items. We also asked the participants to judge their perceived empathy skill learning (PESL) by asking two items that covered cognitive and emotional empathy skills ... Finally, we surveyed the perceived feedback accuracy (PFA) ... and we asked three qualitative questions.
answer_4.guideline: Survey with Likert scale items for ITU (3 items), PESL (2 items), and PFA, plus open-ended questions.
